description: Mars Haritası projemizle Mars’ta hayatta kalmayı keşfetmeyi ve gezegenler arası yaşamı araştırmayı hedefliyoruz. Bilime, uzaya ve teknolojiye ilgi duyan; yaratıcı, takım çalışmasına yatkın ve çözüm odaklı kişileri ekibimize bekliyoruz. Harita tasarımı, araştırma, kodlama ve fikir geliştirme becerilerine sahip takım arkadaşlarıyla birlikte NASA verilerinden yararlanarak yenilikçi bir proje geliştirmek istiyoruz!
summary: Mars Guardian is a browser-based, interactive multi-layered mapping workspace designed to support safer human exploration and surface traverses (Marswalks) on Mars.The project addresses the critical challenge of data fragmentation and mobility hazards during astronaut extravehicular activities, where terrain, slopes, dust, and environmental conditions pose severe risks, and relevant scientific data is scattered across different missions and resolutions. Mars Guardian tackles this by integrating key datasets—such as MOLA topography, TES surface properties, and THEMIS thermal mosaics—into a single interface where users can select coordinates, calculate great-circle distances, and view data limitations.This project is vital because it shifts route planning from simple geometric estimation to evidence-based risk assessment, enhancing astronaut safety and optimizing mission success on the Red Planet.
details: Mars Guardian is a browser-based, interactive Mars map designed as a mission-planning workspace to help astronauts and researchers make safer route decisions during human exploration. It works by bringing multiple scientific perspectives and data layers—such as MOLA topography, TES surface properties, and THEMIS thermal imagery—into a single interface, allowing users to select start and destination points and calculate straight-line distances. The primary benefit of the project is that it provides essential context for route planning by combining distance, terrain hazards, and environmental conditions into one tool, aiming to reduce mission uncertainty and improve safety. Developed using JavaScript and AI-assisted map visualization, the project is creative because it rethinks mission planning through a layered map concept that bridges raw scientific data with practical exploration needs. While developing the prototype, the team carefully considered scientific integrity by clearly separating functional interactive features from placeholders, while also outlining a comprehensive roadmap to ingest real data and implement hazard-aware routing in future versions.
dataRefs: NASA Space Science Data Coordinated Archive (NSSDCA)
